About
item.description:
Strategic Space Power & Emerging Economies is a free, globally accessible course built from original lecture notes on space policy, technology, and strategy.

Author: Oko Jokwu Kenogbole
Background: M.Sc. Advanced IT — Embedded Systems Design
License: All Rights Reserved. Free for personal and educational use.

What This Course Covers

  • Foundations of space power and policy
  • Satellite technology, payloads, and orbital operations
  • Space economy, PPP models, and African strategy
  • Space security, law, and AI
  • Capability building and human capital
